name: email-template-to-dnd
title: Email HTML to drag-and-drop design
summary: Turn email HTML into a design that opens in Brevo's drag-and-drop editor, and save it as a template.

tool_notes.email_editor_create_template: Save only a design returned by Brevo's HTML-to-design conversion, never a hand-written design. Confirm name, type, subject and sender with the user first. Transactional templates are created inactive.
